xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:NameOfTheCompany: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: Notes: 1 The UFR of Co. have been reviewed by AC & approved by the BoD at their respective meetings held on 09.02.2023. SA have conducted limited review of UFR. 2 The UFR have been prepared in accordance with Ind-AS as prescribed u/s 133 of the Co. Act read with Co. (Ind-AS) Rules, 2015. 3 RB vide CC No. CC60 of 2019 has increased catering tariff for post & pre-paid trains. However, the effect of enhancement of LF from 18.11.19 to 22.03.20 (for post paid trains) and 27.11.21 to 31.12.22 (for post & pre-paid trains) has not been ascertained & recognized on acc. of inc. in catering tariff as per CC-60 of 2019 issued by RB, since due to Pandemic, sales assessment by Co. was pending which is now under finalization. 4 During FY 22, Rs. 2713.32 lakhs was paid & charged to revenue on acc. of 15% Rly share in profits of Railneer plants up to FY 21 as Rlys have not agreed with Co. i.e. railneer is part of catering segment which is in loss & also demands 40% revenue share for PPP Plants. No provision was made for FY 22 in view of loss incurred in Railneer segment after considering above payment of Rs.2713.32 lakhs as expense for that year. These matters/amounts are subject to confirmation & reconciliation with Rlys. 5 As per tender, 4 PPP Railneer plants, DCOs are to be reimbursed, GST on sales net of ITC availed by them. The impact of Rs. 309.28 lakhs was accounted for in FY22 except for 1 plant where ITC claimed by DCO were not available. Due to non-availability of ITC claimed by respective DCOs of 2 plants for 9 mths ending 31.12.2022 & 1 plant for qtr ending dec. 22, same could not be accounted & DCOs have represented against IRCTC for ITC. Co. intends to take opinion on this matter from Ex-ASG. 6 The Anti Profiteering Authority issued notice dtd 25.02.2022 for profiteering of Rs.5041.44 Lakhs u/s 171 of CGST Act, 2017 for not passing benefit of tax reduction to consumers. SCN has contested by Co. & matter was argued in Aug, 22 but final order is awaited. The proceedings under the notice issued by Anti Profiteering Authority, therefore, will now be concluded by CCI. 7 Arbitration award was pronounced in April, 22 of Rs.7400 Lakhs plus simple int. @6% pa from July, 2018 onwards, in favour of certain licensees which represents principal amount towards claims for supply of welcome drinks not paid to licensees & recovery of differential costs for supply of regular meals to the passengers on instructions of Rlys whereas price of combo meal, which is lower than price of regular meal, was reimbursed to these licensees. The main liability in this matter would be of Rlys & Co. has right to recovery from Rlys. Co. has filed objections against Arbitration award & same was listed before H’ble HC of Delhi on 28.09.22. The next date of hearing is 28.03.23. 8 For the qtr. & 09 months ended 31.12.22 exceptional income of Rs.135.31 lakhs include excess provision written back for PYs relating to Tejas trains in line with the waiver allowed by Rly. For Custody & Fixed Haulage charges. For FY22, net Exceptional expenses of Rs.400.45 Lakhs includes (i) Rs. 2248.54 Lakhs being reversal of excess provisions for PYs relating to PRP, (ii) Rs.2713.32 lakhs being expense on account of 15% Rly share in profits of Railneer plants up to 31.3.2021 (refer Note no.4); & (iii) Rs.64.33 Lakhs being excess provisions written back for PYs of various other expenses. 9 In Dec. 22, GOI has further disinvested 400 Lakhs shares of Co. through OFS & proceeds have been realized by GOI. 10 The BOD has declared Interim Dividend of Rs.3.50 per share (FV of Rs. 2/- per share) for FY 2022-23 in its meeting held on 09.02.2023. 11. The fig. for the previous periods have been regrouped/reclassified/restated, wherever considered necessary.
